Sam: Follow-up from the all-hands sales section  drop 1-2 bullets on why we won or lost deals this quarter and a single ask for leadership. Short please.

Diego: Win: predictable pricing + low tail latency resonated with a fintech. Loss: missing signal-routing parity. Ask: decision doc on signal feature priority.

Avery: Lost a mid-market because on-prem install looked heavy. Ask: 1-page Private quickstart + automated install script.

Priya: Demo wins tied to KV cache + batching cost savings. Ask: official benchmark snippet SEs can paste into PRDs.

Lina: CS: Console traces build trust; enterprise loss = KMS/HSM gaps. Ask: timeline for managed KMS integrations.

Jordan: SEs report confusion on model variants/fallbacks. Ask: "Which model to pick" 3-tier cheat sheet (latency / cost / quality).

Mali: Customer story: health startup picked us after an offline eval where caching cut costs ~30%. Docs clarity sold it. Ask: update caching docs and add example notebooks.

Diego: Procurement friction on reserved contracts (billing cadence). Ask: sales+legal sync to create a mid-market contract template.

Sam: OK I'll triage these asks into a board: quickstart, benchmark snippet, KMS timeline, model guide, caching docs, contract template. Reply +1 to confirm or add one quick item.

Avery: +1 and add: Console onboarding checklist for Private (expected time per step).

Priya: +1  I'll draft the benchmark snippet this week.

Lina: +1  will post KMS ETA in #eng-security by EOD Friday.

Jordan: +1  will draft the 3-tier guide and post in #eng-ml for review.

ops-bot: Reminder: all-hands survey posted.

Sam: Thanks all  will create triage board and ping owners tomorrow. Add short customer quotes here if you have them for PRDs.:thumbsup:
